_doc: Launch file of modal_layout_jobs.py: the Layout-To-Render IC-LoRA worker (S3, brief BRIEFS_S3_T0B_AND_T1_CARD_ka.md item 1, 2026-11-20): Blender grey layout.mp4 + ONE Gemini picture on frame 0 + 1-2 sentences -> a 10 s LTX-2.5 clip, `ltx_pipelines.ic_lora` at the pinned LTX-2 commit. A NEW file beside the protected ltx/launch.json (never edited; the LTX pins below are copied from it and a test keeps them equal). Every number marked estimate is unmeasured until rung L3 on the GPU measures it; nothing here has run on a GPU.
module_note: ltx_pipelines/ic_lora.py main() at the pinned commit; its argparse read 2026-11-20 (docs/LTX_LAYOUT_JOBS.md section 2)

lora.pins_source: config/cloud_pins.json models.video_ltx_layout_lora (sha256 read from the Hub API at revision bd765d55 on 2026-11-06); size from the Hub listing 2026-11-20

settings.stage_2_ic_lora_why: the model card's own example command passes --stage-2-ic-lora and says a keyframe is used on both stages; the CLI default runs stage 2 on the bare checkpoint. Followed from the card, NOT measured: it adds the reference to stage 2 (more tokens, more memory); L3 measures it. Open for the plan thread (docs/LTX_LAYOUT_JOBS.md section 7, Q-L2).
settings.first_frame_index_why: the card writes the first frame at temporal position -1 (the ComfyUI node); at the pinned commit ImageAction/assert_in_clip refuse any frame_idx < 0 and frame 0 is the 'replace' binding, so the CLI takes 0.
settings.sampler_note: the card's `euler_ancestral` and CFG 1 are not CLI arguments at the pinned commit (the distilled sigma schedule is fixed: stage 1 8 steps, stage 2 3 steps; no --negative-prompt, no CFG flag); nothing to pass.

native.source: CH-02 / D-133 (1280x704@24); T0 layouts are 241 frames at 24 fps (PR #222 docs/BLENDER_SCENE.md)

smoke.why: the smallest legal 8k+1 clip: with caps.smoke_usd 0.20 the function window is only about 100 s (see caps_note), so the smoke measures weight residency and the first denoise, NOT the peak of a 241-frame clip. A longer smoke needs a higher cap: the coordinator's decision (docs/LTX_LAYOUT_JOBS.md Q-L1).

prices_source: cloud/modal_schedule.py (the same card as the P2 judge launch, PR #221); 8 CPU / 64 GiB would be 3.3872 (computed, not chosen)
host_memory_note: 4 CPU / 32 GiB is the size of the brief's $2.9428/h and of the judge launch. The LTX H100 launch uses 8 CPU / 96 GiB. Whether 32 GiB of host RAM holds the 46 GB transformer load is UNMEASURED: the smoke records the container's peak RSS and the cgroup peak; an OOM kill is a stop-and-write, not a retry on a bigger box.

stage.why: L2 on a CPU container (never the GPU): downloads the IC-LoRA (1.3 GB) and checks its sha256; the five base files W5 staged on 2026-11-19 are checked by size and, only with hash_base, by sha256 (a full re-hash of ~46 GB is not inside the brief's $0.10). Its timeout comes from the cap: about 996 s. Estimate, unmeasured.

runner_why: ic_lora has no in-process session in this repo (modal_ltx_jobs.LtxSession wraps the distilled main only); every clip is its own CLI process with the same arguments the docs list. CH-01 (inproc) is an LTX-worker rule on the protected launch; this worker does not call cheapest.launch_problems for it, the coordinator's note on that is docs/LTX_LAYOUT_JOBS.md Q-L3.
caps_note: coordinator 2026-11-20 09:35 UTC (owner: yes to everything, item ceiling $2.00 = smoke 0.20 + T1 0.80 + T3 1.00): smoke 0.20 and T1 (`main`, one clip: Blender layout, moving camera, film line) 0.80 together are the $1.00 of T1; T3 (`chain`, one scene 3 clips, each from the previous clip's frame) is its own launch at 1.00. The ledger line is 2.5 only because its 80 % rule must let the three worst-case reservations (2.0) through; the item's real ceiling is the sum of the three launch caps, 2.0. cold_start_s 60 and margin_s 60 are ESTIMATES; every window below is unmeasured.
chain_note: hand-over pick and window follow modal_ltx_jobs.handover_frame: 'last' unless a job's continue_frame says best_tail (window 1.5 s). max_hop_without_word is CT-1 (W5).
